tasks.label: Build debug apk and install
tasks.command: export NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:10808 HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:10808 ALL_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:10808; npm run cap:sync:android && JAVA_HOME="${workspaceFolder}/.tmp-jdk21/Contents/Home" ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" sh ./android/gradlew -p ./android :app:assembleDebug && (adb install -r -d ./android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk || true)
